title: SSE test-run publication captures and validates the complete history projection cut under StateInner (publish_delta_locked / test_run_history_projection_locked)
outcome: Publishing test-run changes over SSE no longer captures or validates the complete test-run history projection cut while holding StateInner. The lock work for a publication is bounded by the changed rows, not by total history. Ordered revisions and the DTO contract are unchanged.
acceptance: publish_delta_locked's TestRunChanged handling and test_run_history_projection_locked no longer capture or validate the complete TestRunProjectionCut under StateInner. The under-lock work for one publication batch is bounded by its changed rows, and one immutable transport cut is shared per batch. Ordered revisions and the DTO contract are unchanged.

A behaviour test that fails before the fix shows that the under-lock capture work for a publication is the same with or without a large unrelated terminal history (counter-based, no elapsed-time assertion), and passes after.
The review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
